data.title: ‘Nightlife sandbox’ to enforce laws on Khao San
data.description: The government plans to introduce a sandbox scheme covering Khao San and Rambuttri roads in Bangkok to improve law enforcement at entertainment venues and prevent corruption among state officials.

data.title: Rangers win praise for ‘heavy tortoise mission’ in forest
data.description: Wildlife rangers at Si Phang Nga National Park have won public praise for taking turns carrying a 20-kilogramme Asian forest tortoise back into the forest after it wandered towards a nearby community.

data.title: Vietnamese women arrested for prostitution on Sukhumvit Rd
data.description: Authorities have arrested seven Vietnamese women on charges of soliciting prostitution in the Sukhumvit area of Bangkok and are preparing to deport them.

data.title: ‘Zombie pods’ seized ahead of Halloween night
data.description: More than 3,000 electronic cigarettes and “zombie pods” worth nearly 3 million baht have been seized in the Northeast in a crackdown on smuggled products ahead of Halloween celebrations.

data.title: Russia and Thailand Panel Urges Reform and EEC Model to Unlock $100m Property Market
data.description: Bangkok forum hears demand for Thai real estate is surging despite rigid ownership caps, with investors directed toward the Eastern Economic Corridor and joint ventures

data.title: Russia and Thailand Eye Longevity Partnership to Build Asia’s Wellness Hub
data.description: Forum panel urges prevention, personalised diagnostics and healthier homes, as Russian technology and Thai hospitality are pitched as a joint offer

data.title: Russia and Thailand seek new healthcare industry partnerships
data.description: Russia and Thailand see openings for joint pharmaceutical production, vaccine research, medical devices and genomics, but costs and regulatory barriers remain.

data.title: Russia and Thailand Panel Calls for Joint Payment Sandbox to Bridge Trade Gap
data.description: Bangkok forum hears bankers, officials and investors back a bilateral “safe harbour” sandbox, middle-layer links and stablecoin rails to ease payments

data.title: Queen Suthida appointed WADA Global Ambassador for Clean Sport
data.description: Her Majesty Queen Suthida Bajrasudhabimalalakshana has become the first recipient of the World Anti-Doping Agency's (WADA) Global Ambassador for Clean Sport title, in recognition of her role as an international sporting role model and her contribution to promoting clean sport.

data.title: Arnon and four others   jailed for royal defamation
data.description: The Criminal Court has sentenced lawyer and protest leader Arnon Nampa and four co-defendants to two years and eight months in prison each for royal defamation, without suspension.

data.title: Rayong factory’s licence suspended over waste
data.description: Authorities have suspended a Rayong factory's licence after inspectors found more than 1,000 tonnes of industrial waste piled outside its building, with initial tests indicating the presence of potentially hazardous heavy metals.

data.title: 10 Thai horror films for your Halloween marathon
data.description: As Halloween night approaches and cinephiles hunt for genuinely terrifying cinema, one region stands unmatched in its ability to deliver pure, unadulterated dread: Thailand.

data.title: Democrats say 'no' to debate without vote
data.description: The Democrat Party has ruled out a separate parliamentary debate without a vote, saying the opposition should focus on its planned no-confidence motion with a vote.

data.title: White House approves Patriot missile sales to Ukraine
data.description: WASHINGTON - The Trump administration on Friday approved the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine, the State Department said, but the Ukrainian president warned deliveries could take years.

data.title: Fears of violence as France braces for Halloween protests
data.description: PARIS - France on Saturday braced for a third weekend of protests coinciding with Halloween, as shops boarded up and authorities scrambled to prevent a repeat of the street violence that swept the country two weeks ago.

data.title: Thailand braces for US-Iran fallout
data.description: The National Security Council (NSC) will convene an urgent meeting on Wednesday to review national preparedness measures amid growing concerns over the situation in the Middle East.

data.description: The political balance in Hat Yai, the commercial heart of southern Thailand, could be tested by more than the threat of flooding.

data.title: US and allies pledge ‘complete' North Korea denuclearisation
data.description: SEOUL - The United States, South Korea and Japan reaffirmed their commitment to the “complete denuclearisation” of North Korea on Saturday, as Pyongyang continues to reject disarmament ahead of possible talks with Washington.
